entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane rejoined from five shards after the Conflux, now caught in a massive inter-shard war.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara with a rigid caste society and stone walls erected against Jund, Grixis and Esper.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of etherium-enhanced vedalken and artificers.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A dead, necromantic shard of Alara.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A predatory shard of Alara of dragons, goblins and warrior-clans.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A jungle shard of Alara home to the Nacatl and elves.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Dragon planeswalker whose fear-spreading message is contrasted with the Knight of New Alara's.

entities.name: Ajani Vengeant
entities.description: Planeswalker who ignited his spark after the trauma of his brother's death and gained red magic to seek revenge.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: A Grixis demon who remembers when he was the most fearsome being on young Alara and wants to restore his position.

entities.name: Knight of New Alara
entities.description: A knight attempting to forge a whole new society for Alarans of all cultures.

entities.name: Vedalken Heretic
entities.description: An Esper vedalken who has gone native in Naya, studying the Filigree Texts through nature.

entities.name: Bloodbraid Elf
entities.description: A Cylian elf who left her kin to join the warrior-clans of Jund.

entities.name: Vithian Renegades
entities.description: Surviving Grixis humans who fought their way out of that dead land.

entities.name: Nacatl
entities.description: The leonin of Naya, some of whom have joined Bant.

events.summary: Alarans face choices in the rejoined plane and inter-shard war: invading, joining other shards, forging new paths, being conscripted, or holding to the status quo.
events.quote: All over Alara, people are now facing just these kinds of dilemmas, and making the choices that determine their fates.

events.summary: Walls are erected to keep Jund, Grixis and Esper from encroaching on Bant and Naya.
events.quote: helping defend the stone walls recently erected to keep Jund, Grixis, and Esper from encroaching on the sunnier lands of Bant and Naya

events.summary: Grixis humans flee their dead land in an exodus.
events.quote: They've left the horrors of Grixis—and, likely, some weaker members of their own family—behind them

events.summary: An Esper mind-mage seizes control of a Jund dragon and sends it to the front lines.
events.quote: Some enterprising Esper mind-mage has taken over the brain of this ferocious monster

events.summary: Spectral kings and queens of old Alara begin to return to protect soldiers.
events.quote: Kings and queens of old Alara have begun to return in spectral form

events.summary: Ajani ignites his spark after his brother's death and is open to red magic.
events.quote: Ajani, thanks to the trauma behind his brother's death, not only ignites his planeswalker spark but also becomes open to furious red magic

relations.note: optimistic message set against Bolas's fear-spreading one
relations.quote: It remains to be seen whether his optimistic sort of message, or Bolas's fear-spreading one

relations.note: left Cylian kin for Jund's warrior-clans
relations.quote: Bloodbraid Elf once lived among her Cylian kin, but sees more opportunities for quick and bloody action among the warrior-clans of Jund.

relations.note: an Esper vedalken gone native in Naya
relations.quote: an Esper vedalken who has "gone native" in the verdant jungles of Naya
Malfegor is another Grixis monster who's trying to ply a strategy of business as usual.
